It's more peaceful than I thought...
Let's ask around to find something.
Hmm... Nothing...
Let's ask again somewhere else... Maybe check the Town Square...
It should be in the south east from here...
Still nothing… Is Atlantia wrong about this place?
Maybe I should look around more… But the rumor about monsters makes me worried.
Let’s check on that first, maybe I can find something there too.
According to Condy, the Forest is south of the Market. The Market should be east of here.
Quite a lovely forest, I think I can scavenge for food he–
HELP!!!
Remmie!!
Get up, Remmie!!
Ugh...
I need to help them!
Huft... That's one hell of Boribas...
Wow! You're so cool, big sis!
Yeah! You can slay that big Boribas in no time!
Thank you, big sis.
Thank you, kids. But now, I need to tend your wound first.
(Hmm... This kid is a demon, but using healing magic should be fine...)
Now it's healed!
Wow! You can use healing magic too, big sis? Thank you so much!
You're so cool, big sis!
I want to be like you when I grow up!
Hehe, then you should train and study hard, little girl.
Hehe, you sound like the Prince.
(The Prince? The demon Prince?)
Really? When did you meet him?
It's been a while since we last saw him. Mom says that he is busy these past few weeks.
Yeah! We miss his class! He always do cool things!
(That's unexpected... Why does he teach commoners?)
Is that so? Well then, you better go home now. It's dangerous here.
You shouldn't be near the forest without any adult around.
Okay!
See you later, big sis!
Thank you, big sis!
Well, that was an unexpected news about him...
I need to dig more about this...
(Huh?... Isn't that...)
Hey, you! Wait!
Hm? Yes?
You, demon! Did you release that big ass Boribas to attack the children?!
Huh? What are you talking about?
There's no way a big Boribas like that to be this near to a settlement.
You must be the one that bring it here!
What the hell are you talking about?
You can deceive the people, but you can't fool me!
You try to look good in front of other people, but you bring a monster here to hurt the children!
Miss, you really should calm down.
I don't even understand half of what you say!
Enough! You will die here, right now, Demon Prince!
Ugh!
(What?! How is his magic so strong?!)
Don't go around and attack people, you fool!
You may be a Hero, but this empire don't need one.
Oh, but you may be useful for something.
If you interested in the Truth, come to me. Let's have a conversation.
I will give these for you. Don't die here.
Ugh...
